title: IIT ISM Dhanbad Notification 2026 - Apply for Various Junior Research Fellow Posts
description: Indian Institute of Technology (Indian School of Mines) Dhanbad (IIT(ISM) Dhanbad) has declared the official notification for 01 Junior Research Fellow job. Candidates who have completed their B.E/ B.Tech or M.E/ M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering can use this chance and apply for these posts. Here, we have included more information about the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for the IIT ISM Dhanbad Notification 2026 .
